story_info.title: Oliver and Pip's Berry Quest

slides.title: Oliver and Pip's Berry Quest
slides.text: It was a bright Tuesday morning in Sunny Forest. Oliver Fox had his clever amber eyes open for fun. He saw his friend Pip the bird. Pip was a small blue bird with a yellow chest and tiny orange feet. Pip was flapping her wings near a tall berry bush. She looked sad.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox is in Sunny Forest, sees his friend Pip looking sad near a berry bush.

slides.title: A Tricky Problem
slides.text: Oliver went to Pip. 'Hello, Pip! Why do you look so worried?' he asked. Pip chirped, 'Oh, Oliver! My favourite red berries are too high! I cannot reach them.' Oliver looked at the tall bush. He saw how far up the juicy berries were. 'That is a tricky problem,' he said, thinking hard.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver asks Pip why she is sad. Pip explains she cannot reach the high berries. Oliver considers the problem.

slides.title: Oliver's Big Idea
slides.text: Oliver put his paw on his chin. 'Let's solve it together!' he said with a smile. He looked around. Oliver saw a long, sturdy branch lying on the ground. 'Pip, maybe this branch can help us!' he chirped. Pip looked at the branch. She did not know what to do. But Oliver had a plan.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver uses his catchphrase 'Let's solve it together!' and finds a long branch as part of his plan.

slides.title: Working as Friends
slides.text: Oliver carefully picked up the long branch. It was just right. He held it up to the berry bush. The branch reached almost to the top! 'Now, Pip, fly onto the end of the branch,' Oliver said gently. Pip was a little scared, but she trusted Oliver. She flew and landed softly on the branch.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver holds the branch for Pip. Pip, trusting Oliver, lands on the branch to reach the berries.

slides.title: Sweet Berries for Everyone
slides.text: From the branch, Pip could easily reach the red berries! She picked a few with her tiny beak. 'Thank you, Oliver!' she chirped happily. Oliver smiled. They shared the sweet berries. Working together made them both feel very happy. Friends help each other, always!
slides.speaker_notes: Pip gets the berries, thanks Oliver. They share the berries, feeling happy about working together and friendship.
